market_summary.trend: BTC at ~$62,810 on Jul 17 (04:06 EDT), down from $65K resistance highs on Jul 15-16. BTC failed twice to break $65,100-$65,471. Risk-off mode after US-Iran escalation. Up ~4% weekly but momentum cooling.
